provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Mage Knight Game Walkthrough (WizKids) - First Reconnaissance scenario

steps.text: Scenario: First Reconnaissance (find the city within 3 Rounds: Day, Night, Day)
Starting tile on its "A" side
11 Countryside tiles (green) sorted by number, facedown, 1 on top{x}
Core tiles (brown): shuffle the city and non-city tiles apart; 1 random city + 2 non-city shuffled under the Countryside pile
Reveal tiles 1 and 2 next to the starting tile as shown, all numbers facing the same way as the A
steps.note: Leave room on the table for the map to grow; nothing goes past the coastline

steps.text: Sort the enemy and ruin tokens into 7 facedown piles by their backs and randomize each
On the two "Orc Khan" spaces: draw a token from the matching pile, faceup
Advanced Actions: use only cards 1-16 (box 17-28), shuffle facedown; reveal the offer as shown
Shuffle the Spell deck facedown; reveal the offer as shown
Shuffle the Artifact deck; Wound cards faceup in a pile
Regular Units (silver) shuffled facedown; reveal {n} as the Unit offer; Elite Units stay boxed
steps.note: First game: the offer must include a Unit with the village icon - reshuffle if not

steps.text: Night Tactics facedown by the Day/Night board; Day Tactics faceup in the center
Site Description cards for the start area out: Village, Magical Glade / Crystal Mines, Marauding Orcs; box the City cards
Fame and Reputation board: each player's Shield on 0 Fame and on the center of the Reputation track
Day/Night board Day side up
Mana tokens as a bank
Roll {n} mana dice into the Source; reroll gold and black until at least half show a basic color
Each player picks (or draws) a Hero and all its components; box unused heroes
Round Order tokens randomized in a column left of the Day/Night board
Level tokens sorted faceup (1-2 on top) on your Hero card; the blank one symbol up as your first Command token
Shuffle your 10 Skill tokens facedown; Skills Description card nearby
Shuffle your 16-card Deed deck; draw 5
Hero figure in front of you (it enters on the portal on your first turn)
Max 3 crystals of a color in your Inventory
One Source die per turn; reroll it when returning it
First game: leave out Player vs. Player combat
Round 1 (Day): each player picks a Day Tactic, which sets the turn order
